scope: Independent CPU cook, GLB semantics, image stream validation, deterministic page/source binding, bounded allocations and transactional output review. GltfDecoder.cpp and its test were subsequently repaired by this reviewer.

findings.before: M3 and render decode accepted an extra 4-byte BIN suffix not covered by buffer.byteLength and accepted nonzero alignment bytes.
findings.after: Render decoder permits at most three zero padding bytes.
findings.regression: New test failed before change, then passed with valid one-byte zero padding and rejected nonzero/excess padding.

findings.before: No NORMAL but valid preexisting TANGENT parallel to computed flat normal caused the render decoder to reject the primitive.
findings.after: Flat-normal path regenerates tangent basis and ignores authored tangent direction as required by core glTF.
findings.regression: Valid +Z authored tangent on XY triangle reproduced failure, then 3 reconstructed vertices passed normal/tangent checks.

findings.detail: The initial concern about missing buffer range/component-type checks is already handled in M3 ValidateAccessorGeometry before the renderer decodes. No duplicate change added.

validation.link_contract: Scoped helper invoked actual BuildVisualRuntime link_target including source/link/symbol/dependency checks

boundary_notes: GPU page load alone verifies the declared source digest and structure. VerifyCookedScene compares complete canonical pages against source-decoded content at the visual entry point.
512 MiB scene/page budgets describe encoded/decoded payload caps. GenerateBasis and page/source comparisons also allocate temporary vectors, so this is not a process RSS ceiling.
Image decode is Windows WIC-backed and strict entropy prechecks precede pixels. PNG/JPEG source content remains encoded in the current .engpu page, mips are constructed at renderer startup.
Advanced materials, animation/skin/morph, block compression, virtual geometry, dynamic GI, and final UE/4K acceptance retain their staged status.
post_review_byte_normalization: First-party JPEG bridge line endings normalized to LF for repository storage; generated libjpeg config whitespace normalized and recorded in PATCHES.json. No executable statements changed; full rendering tests rerun in m42-final.
